title: Military abductions of abductees after gray abductions
place_text: Air Force bases and underground bases, USA

tellings.quote: some of these abductees were being would be abducted by gray aliens and then when they were turn returned to their homes the military would show up

plain: Some people who say they were taken by gray aliens, the small gray-skinned beings of many abduction accounts, also say that after they were returned home the military showed up and took them again, to Air Force bases and underground bases in the US. A researcher named Tim Alberino retells this, drawing on the work of an abduction researcher named Karla Turner. If true, it would mean the military knows about the abductions and follows up on them.
